title: China's CXMT Starts Mass Production of LPDDR6, Set for Xiaomi's New Phone: Is Chinese DRAM Closing In on the Global Leaders?
excerpt: China's CXMT has started mass production of LPDDR6, and reports say it will be used in Xiaomi's next-generation smartphone. We sort out, with sources, what LPDDR6 does and whether Chinese DRAM could close in on Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron.
